blocks.title: Homogeneous equilibrium
blocks.text: Woh equilibrium system jis mein tamam reactants aur products ek hi phase (halat) mein hon.

blocks.title: Heterogeneous equilibrium
blocks.text: Woh equilibrium jis mein reactants aur products ek se zyada phases mein hon, heterogeneous equilibrium kehlata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Homogeneous aur heterogeneous equilibria mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Homogeneous mein har species ek hi phase mein hoti hai (sab gases ya sab liquids). Heterogeneous mein do ya zyada phases hote hain (jaise solids ke saath gas). Misal: CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) heterogeneous hai; khalis solids expression mein nahi aate, is liye Kc = [CO₂].

blocks.prompt: b) Reversible reaction jab equilibrium ke qareeb aati hai to forward reaction ki rate kyun kam hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Forward rate reactants ki concentration par depend karti hai. Reactants products mein badalte jate hain, is liye har second kam collisions hoti hain aur forward rate girti hai. Saath hi products barhne se reverse rate barhti hai, yahan tak ke equilibrium par dono barabar ho jati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein ion HCO³⁻ chhapa hai. Sahi ion HCO₃⁻ hai (teen oxygen atoms, charge 1−), jaise sawal ki pehli line mein likha hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Soda water ki botal mein CO₂(g) pani mein ghuli CO₂ (HCO₃⁻ aur H⁺) ke saath equilibrium mein hai. (i) Is equilibrium ke liye dhakkan band kyun hona chahiye? (ii) Dhakkan kholne par equilibrium kis taraf shift hota hai?
blocks.explanation: (i) Dhakkan band ho to pani se nikalne wali CO₂ botal ke andar rehti hai aur usi rate se dobara ghulti hai; system band hai, is liye equilibrium qaim rehta hai. (ii) Dhakkan kholne se CO₂ gas bahar nikal jati hai, is liye equilibrium left (reactants ki taraf) shift hota hai: ghuli hui CO₂ bulbulon ki shakal mein nikalti rehti hai aur soda phika ho jata hai.

items: Homogeneous: ek phase (ammonia banna, SO₃ banna, ester banna).
Heterogeneous: ek se zyada phases (CaCO₃ ka tootna, carbon aur steam, loha aur steam); khalis solids Kc mein nahi aate.
